name: Assurant
description: Assurant insures and services consumer purchases rather than people: extended-warranty and protection contracts on mobile phones, consumer electronics and appliances (sold through mobile carriers, device makers and retailers), vehicle service contracts, and lender-placed homeowners insurance. Global Lifestyle is 78 percent of revenue and Global Housing 23 percent. It earns premiums and fees, and also provides the administrative support and related services; it earns more per dollar of revenue in Housing (adjusted EBITDA $859M on $2.9B) than in Lifestyle ($801M on $9.9B). Housing earnings swing with hurricanes and other catastrophes ($199M of reportable catastrophe losses in 2025).
